labels.condition.blinded.summary: Can't see: your attacks have disadvantage, attacks against you have advantage.
labels.condition.charmed.summary: You can't attack the creature that charmed you.
labels.condition.deafened.summary: Can't hear: checks that rely on hearing fail.
labels.condition.frightened.summary: Your attacks have disadvantage and you can't willingly move closer to the source.
labels.condition.incapacitated.summary: You can't take actions or reactions.
labels.condition.invisible.summary: Unseen: your attacks have advantage, attacks against you have disadvantage.
labels.condition.paralyzed.summary: Incapacitated, speed 0; Str and Dex saves auto-fail; hits within 5 feet are critical.
labels.condition.petrified.summary: Incapacitated, speed 0; Str and Dex saves auto-fail; you have resistance to damage.
labels.condition.poisoned.summary: Poisoned: disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
labels.condition.prone.summary: Prone: your attacks have disadvantage; standing up costs half your speed.
labels.condition.restrained.summary: Speed 0; your attacks have disadvantage, attacks against you have advantage, Dex saves have disadvantage.
labels.condition.stunned.summary: Incapacitated; Str and Dex saves auto-fail; attacks against you have advantage.
labels.condition.unconscious.summary: Incapacitated, speed 0; Str and Dex saves auto-fail; hits within 5 feet are critical.
labels.condition.dazed.summary: Can only do one of: move, take an action, or take a Bonus Action on its next turn.
